title: Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 18: Rabbi Shmuel said in his name, "All the honor that he (Moses) saw in this world, he took nothing at all from the principal." But the statement is brought in Shemot Rabbah ch. 47, par. 3, and there it reads: Rabbi Yirmeyah said in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Yitzchak; and in the Tanchuma the words "in the name of Rabbi Shmuel" were displaced from their place.

notes.text: The proposed repaired chain is Yirmeyah reporting Shmuel bar Yitzchak; the supplied title instead joins Yitzchak to Yirmeyah. Hyman explains this through displacement of the words in the name of Rabbi Shmuel.

The consulted Shemot Rabbah 47:3 names Rabbi Yirmeyah reporting Rabbi Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak. The additional title Rav belongs to that witness; Hyman’s quoted Tanchuma reading and explanation of displaced words are retained as his account.
